name: Black Bean Soup
summary: Canned black beans simmered with tomato and cumin, then mashed in the pot. Served over rice.
instructions: Start the rice: 200 g rice with 400 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
Mash about half the beans right in the pot with a potato masher, or blend a few ladles and stir them back in. This thickens the soup.
Season with salt and serve over scoops of rice.

glutenFree.notes: Beans, tomatoes, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Most Campbell's ready-to-use broths are gluten-free, but check the label on whichever broth you buy.

budgetNotes: A squeeze of lime, a spoon of sour cream, or a handful of cheddar on top all work, but none are needed.
Freezes well for up to three months.
Rinsing the canned beans removes a good share of the sodium.
